set.body: Add an explicit contextual fidelity profile over the existing admission/replay path. Recompute attribution and held identity from exact input recordings, expose only declared source/selected-recall evidence closure, require per-question context accounting, preserve unresolved attribution and prior assessments. Keep v1 prompt/recording bytes unchanged. Deliver installed context-sensitive two-recall workflow, adversarial visibility/ownership/preservation tests, mutation evidence and cold review. Native source assessment follows as a separate slice.
set.title: P3 context-aware conditional fidelity through checked holder and identity evidence
